question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Suspend
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Suspend"** means to temporarily stop or halt something. (स्थगित करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The school decided to suspend classes due to the severe weather conditions.
 
 
 
• **"Resume"** means to continue after a pause or interruption. (फिर से शुरू करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After the break, the teacher asked the students to resume their studies.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Suspend'** is **'Resume'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Extend** (विस्तारित करना): To make something longer or larger.

 
 
• **Example:** The company plans to extend its operations to new markets.
 
 
 
• **Terminate** (समाप्त करना): To bring something to an end.
 
 
• **Example:** The contract was terminated due to a breach of terms.
 
 
 
• **Project** (प्रक्षेपित करना): To estimate or forecast something based on present trends.
 
 
• **Example:** The company projected a significant increase in sales for the next quarter.
